spectrum.name: 45_126_complex10_survival
spectrum.description: Same LR-stage content as lr_minimal, plus GUT-scale threshold fields: the components of a complex 10_H and a complex 126_H of SO(10) that are not part of the LR stage (Phi and Delta_R are the light remnants). ASSUMPTION: all listed heavy components sit at one common mass of 1e16 GeV; this is an illustrative choice, not a fitted one. The 30 SO(10)/LR gauge bosons are assumed degenerate with M_GUT (zero log) consistent with the M_X = M_GUT assumption in the proton-lifetime estimator.

input_sensitivity.interpretation: rectangular sensitivity envelope, no covariance or confidence level
